thread:
DeployBot: Starting canary rollout rdo-20260320-91 for release rdx-serve v2.14.2 to prod-canary-A. Change window: 09:10-09:40 UTC. Backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-canary-A (please ack). Monitor p95, error-rate, and quality-evals. Auto fallback configured.

maya: ack — I'll monitor traces and synthetic traffic. standing by. :eyes:

jon: note: pinned image rdx-serve:v2.14.2-quant-20260319. No blocking migrations. Config diff attached in the release notes.

lia: TL;DR backout steps (short):
1) Remove canary weight: routing API set canary=0
2) Scale canary pods to 0 and ensure stable pods at desiredReplicas
3) Undo k8s deployment if needed:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/rdx-api --to-revision=45
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/rdx-api
```
4) Re-pin model-router to rdx-serve:v2.14.1
5) Invalidate / rehydrate caches: redis keys prefixed with model:
6) Open an incident if manual rollback performed.

jon: automated guardrails in this release:
- p95 latency > 500ms for 3m
- request error-rate > 2% for 3m
- evaluation drop > 3 points on canary-eval set for 5 prompts
If triggered, deploy-bot will pause rollout and notify ops.

emily: quick ops commands from runbook:
```
# set routing weights
curl -X POST "https://routing.internal/api/v1/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"service":"rdx-api","weights":{"stable":1.0,"canary":0.0}}'

# pin model back
curl -X POST "https://models.internal/api/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"service":"model-router","tag":"rdx-serve:v2.14.1"}'

# health
curl -sS https://canary-a.prod.redwood.net/health | jq .
```

maya: launching smoke harness now (promptset: smoke_v2). I'll post p50/p95 and errors every 120s.

lia: log query for latency/err spikes:
```
index=prod source=rdx-api | stats avg(latency_ms) by route span=1m
```
Also remember to toggle ff.canary-new-tokenization -> false on backout.

jon: heads up — when undoing k8s check ENV_VERSION and DB_MAX_CONN align across revisions (we hit a mismatch in staging last week).

maya: 09:13 UTC update: p95=150ms, error-rate=0.05%. No issues so far. Holding at 5% traffic.

deploy-ops-bot: Canary eval: -1.8 points on key-evals (threshold 3). Pausing automated ramp and notifying channel.

emily: emergency rollback helper located at ops/playbooks/rollback_canary_A.sh (requires OP_ROLE). Usage:
```
./ops/playbooks/rollback_canary_A.sh --id rdo-20260320-91 --approve
```
It flips routing, pins model, scales down canary, and files an incident.

jon: if we run the helper, capture prompt IDs for failing evals and attach to the ticket for research triage.

maya: 09:22 UTC synthetic still stable. eval drop looks limited to a small prompt subset, opening a quick triage with research.

lia: ordering note for backout: pin model FIRST, then flush caches, then switch traffic. That avoids mismatched cache keys hitting wrong binary.

maya: ack. I'm going to keep at 5% for another 8m, then consider 25% if no further eval regressions.

deploy-ops-bot: Ramp paused at 5% pending manual approval. Use `/deploy authorize rdo-20260320-91` to continue.

jon: I'll wait for maya's go. If we see persistent metric drift after 25% escalate to SRE and run rollback script.

maya: approving now. 09:31 UTC ramping to 25%. :rocket:

lia: logging to backout runbook id rbk-20260320-A91. Please add any manual remediation steps you perform.

maya: 09:39 UTC final check at 25%: p95=165ms, error-rate=0.12%. OK to continue ramp per cadence. Marking canary healthy.

jon: thanks everyone. I'll record the rollout id and pinned tag in release notes and close this thread after full ramp completes. :white_check_mark:
